zh.name: 限期行动与挑战计划
zh.summary: 用清楚期限组织动作，先总览日历，再按日期或阶段给任务。
zh.useWhen: 日期推动递进；区别于按可用容量分配的一般周计划。
zh.instructions: 目标、期限、阶段动作、所需材料与完成条件
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Timed Action Plan
en.summary: Create an Instagram how-to carousel using the timed action plan structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the timed action plan format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
